title: The Night I Replanned
description:
At the halfway point of five years, {name} stopped to think — 'I have to redo the strategy.'

The strategy redrawn then carried all the way here.

Today it's time to review again.

choices.text: Stopping to replan then was right
choices.result_text:
Sometimes stopping to re-see the direction is faster than running on momentum.

The halfway reset shaped the late-game flow.
{name} knows knowing when to stop is a strategy too.

choices.text: Stop and review once more this time too
choices.result_text:
The habit of regularly stopping to review.

It saved {name} from big mistakes several times.
Even when the running speed feels too precious to lose, review time always paid back more than it cost.

title: Going Further from ₩1 Billion
description:
The day {name} crossed ₩1 billion, instead of resting they made a plan — 'I have to go further.'

₩1 billion is an end for some; for {name} it was a waypoint.

That resolve came to mind today.

choices.text: Not stopping at ₩1 billion was right
choices.result_text:
Had they been content at ₩1 billion, they'd have stopped there.

With the goal set at ₩3 billion, ₩1 billion was a checkpoint, not a celebration.
{name} knows the height of your gaze ultimately creates the distance.

choices.text: Still, sometimes stop and breathe
choices.result_text:
Just running eventually exhausts you.

Not resting at ₩1 billion was right, but it can't always be so.
{name} was finding the rhythm between advancing and recovering.

title: The Day ₩3 Billion Looked Farther
description:
The day {name} crossed ₩1 billion, rather than joy they felt anxious — '₩3 billion looks even farther.'

Even before that large number, the goal felt distant.

That sense of distance washed over them again today.

choices.text: Far as it is — one step at a time is the answer
choices.result_text:
Reaching ₩1 billion was one step at a time too.

The remaining distance is the same method. Looking far is a matter of perspective, not impossibility.
{name} looked at their feet again. It starts there.

choices.text: Anxiety as fuel — go more precisely
choices.result_text:
Anxiety isn't to erase but to use.

That sense of distance made {name} more meticulous.
Turn vague fear into a concrete plan, and that itself becomes progress.

title: Deflecting into Investing Talk
description:
When Sangchul brought up his life story, {name} deflected into investing — 'How much was that place?'

Avoiding the deeper conversation comes back sometimes.

Today they sat across from Sangchul again.

choices.text: This time, listen to his story
choices.result_text:
The conversation deflected last time, this time heard to the end.

Sangchul unexpectedly opened up about a lot.
{name} learned belatedly that relationships don't deepen on information exchange alone.

choices.text: I'm comfortable with a transactional bond — keep the line
choices.result_text:
Not every relationship has to be deep.

{name} decided to keep a measured distance from Sangchul.
Whether that's cold or wise — that would be known later.

title: A Beer Instead of Charts
description:
One night in the goshiwon days, instead of watching charts, {name} closed the day with a can of beer.

Those nights of catching a breath were needed too.

Tonight, too, the head is heavy.

choices.text: Tonight too — let myself rest a moment
choices.result_text:
Running without rest isn't a virtue.

Those can-of-beer nights carried {name} to the end.
Knowing how to let yourself rest was a condition for going long too.

choices.text: Rest a moment — then back to the desk
choices.result_text:
Rest isn't stopping — it's recharging.

{name} caught a short breath, then returned to their place.
Knowing that rhythm was the secret to going without burnout.

title: The Night I Told Hyun-su to Sleep
description:
One night in the goshiwon days, instead of overdoing it, {name} told Hyun-su 'get some sleep' and turned in early.

Those nights of looking out for each other.

Today the air of that era suddenly came to mind.

choices.text: Looking out for each other then — was the strength to endure
choices.result_text:
Alone, they'd have tired faster.

Just having someone enduring in the next room made the night less long.
{name} missed the small care of those days.

choices.text: Past that era — I've grown a bit sturdier
choices.result_text:
Past the days of leaning on each other, they now stand alone.

But the warmth received then is melted into the present sturdiness.
{name} knows they owe a lot to those days.

title: Looking at the ₩2.5 Billion One
description:
The day {name} crossed ₩2.5 billion, instead of the ₩1.7 billion listing they looked at a ₩2.5 billion one. 'If I'm going to do it right.'

That ambition comes back sometimes.

Today they opened that listing again.

choices.text: If at all — do it right. Aim higher
choices.result_text:
Lower the goal and you go only that far.

Having looked higher, {name} gained the drive to go farther.
Ambition differs from recklessness — backed by calculation, it's vision.

choices.text: Check the greed — is it too much?
choices.result_text:
A higher goal isn't always right.

{name} coldly weighed whether ₩2.5 billion was ambition or greed.
A goal you can handle and one that breaks you are a paper's width apart.

title: Saying I'll Go Anyway
description:
Four months into Seoul, stuck in a sense of stagnation on a Han River bridge, {name} started walking again — 'you'll go anyway.'

That one step carried all the way here.

Today is another similar moment of stagnation.

choices.text: Like then — even stopped, I walk again
choices.result_text:
Stagnation isn't an end but a brief pause.

Like walking again on that bridge four months in, they decided to walk again today.
{name} knows that stopping and going again is stronger than giving up.

choices.text: This time, change the method and go again
choices.result_text:
If the same method fails, change the method.

Instead of blindly enduring, {name} redrew the path.
'you'll go anyway' had to be followed by a 'how.'

title: Thinking of a Shortcut
description:
Four months into Seoul, stuck in stagnation, {name} thought 'there has to be another way' and considered a shortcut.

That temptation still visits sometimes.

Today 'a faster way' crossed the mind again.

choices.text: I know the temptation of shortcuts — so I guard more
choices.result_text:
Fast roads usually hide traps.

The mind seeking shortcuts then could have led to scams or gambling.
Because {name} knows that temptation, they paused a beat each time.

choices.text: Seek legitimate shortcuts — but keep the principles
choices.result_text:
Raising efficiency and breaking principles are different.

{name} sought smarter paths but held the lines not to cross.
The real shortcut was the road you walk without collapsing.

title: Admitting the Fear
description:
Entering the final stretch, {name} admitted for the first time that they were 'afraid.'

Afraid of collapsing right at the end. Of all this coming to nothing.

Today that fear is beside them again.

choices.text: Admitting the fear — actually became strength
choices.result_text:
Deny fear and it grows. Admit it and you can handle it.

Because they admitted it honestly then, {name} wasn't devoured by it.
Courage isn't the absence of fear — it's going despite it.

choices.text: Afraid — but I trust the self that came this far
choices.result_text:
Coming this far wasn't luck.

It was the result of countless choices and endurances. {name} decided to trust that self.
Building trust atop fear — that was how to walk the final leg.

title: Calculating While Walking
description:
Entering the final stretch, {name} calculated the remaining numbers while walking.

Measured the distance by numbers, not emotion.

Today they're running the calculator in their head again.

choices.text: Seen as numbers — the vague becomes clear
choices.result_text:
Turn a vague 'still far' into concrete numbers and fear becomes a plan.

{name} chose calculation over emotion.
When the remaining distance is visible, so is how to go.

choices.text: Beyond numbers — don't forget why I go
choices.result_text:
Watch only the numbers and you lose the way.

Even while calculating, {name} held onto why they walk this road.
Destination and reason together kept them steady to the end.

title: The Message I Didn't Send
description:
After letting Dae-un go, one night running into a trace of her, {name} wrote her a message, then deleted it without sending.

That unsent message comes back sometimes.

Today they opened that chat window again.

choices.text: This time too — don't send. It's the past
choices.result_text:
An unsent message has meaning too.

There were things to say, but not saying them was for both of them.
{name} closed the window. Some feelings are resolved by not sending.

choices.text: Just a line to check in — send it calmly
choices.result_text:
Sent a single line asking how she was.

No telling if a reply comes. But it beat only burying it.
{name} sent that line not as lingering attachment, but as a knot tied off.

title: Standing in That Spot
description:
After letting Dae-un go, one night running into a trace of her, {name} stood still in that spot for a while.

That moment of pausing comes back sometimes.

Passing a similar place today, their feet stopped again.

choices.text: Acknowledge the feeling — and walk again
choices.result_text:
Not denying the longing, just lingering a moment.

After that, walking again was possible.
{name} didn't regret that paused moment. It was part of the goodbye too.

choices.text: I don't linger long in that spot anymore
choices.result_text:
Before, they stood a long while. Now they glance and pass.

Time had eased the weight of that spot.
{name} calmly accepted that what was let go had truly gone.
